caseno: Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 226 of 1995.
lawyer:
Abdul Malek, Senior Advocate instructed by Md. Aftab Hossain, Advocate-on-Record —For the Petitioner 
Not represented—The Respondent
parties:
Ismail and another ----- Petitioner
Vs.
State ----- Respondent
full_judgment: 5. The prosecution case, as stated by the informant PW 1 Md. Moyezuddin at the trial, is that, on 29-6-89 a cow belonging to accused Habib damaged the paddy field of the informant's cousin Noor Mohammad whose son Kalu @ Kamal impounded the cow. Habib came to the house of the informant at about 1-30 PM and started quarrelling with Kamal. Noor Mohammad asked Habib to get the cow released from impounding. Thereupon Habib twisted the hands of Kamal and started beating him. On hearing row Mokhlesur Rahman @ Tara Mia came out of his house and drove away Habib. Following this incident on 6-7-89 at about 7-30 AM two workmen of acquitted accused Nazrul were passing through the homestead of the informant party when the informant's nephew Mokhlesur Rahman @ Tara Mia, brother Abdur Razzak and cousin Noor Mohammad told the workmen that they would not be allowed to pass through the thoroughfare, as their employer did not allow the informant party's workmen to pass through the thoroughfare, behind the house of Nazrul on the previous day. Nazrul's workmen went back. Then acquitted accused Fazlul Huq Abdur Rahman. Nazrul and Ibrahim called the informant party to come out of their house. The informant himself, Mokhlesur Rahman, deceased Noor Mohammad, Abdur Razzak and PW 2 Md. Anwar Hossain were at that time present at the outer courtyard of their house. They looked at the north and found all the accused persons rushing towards them with dao, lathi, dagger, fala, knife, ramdao, bamboo bung, etc. in their hands. On arrival at the courtyard they started beating the informant and the inmates of the house. Condemned-prisoner No. 1 Ismail inflicted a blow on the left knee of the informant's cousin Abdur Razzak on receiving which he fell on the ground. Condemned-prisoner No. 2 Mostafa @ Mosta came running and sat upon the chest of Abdur Razzak and started hitting him on his chest and belly with a dagger in his hand. Condemned-prisoner No. 1 Ismail came running and inflicted a ramdao blow on the head of Mokhlesur Rahman @ Tara Mia, cousin of the informant. Tara Mia fell down on the ground. Condemned-prisoner No. 2 Mostafa @ Mosta then alighted from the chest of Abdur Razzak and came running upon the chest of Tara Mia and started hitting him on his chest with the dagger in his hand. PW 7 Most Laily Begum, wife of Mokhlesur Rahman @ Tara Mia, tried to prevent condemned-prisoner No. 2 from hitting her husband but the said condemned-prisoner struck her with the dagger in his hand on her left thigh and caused bleeding injuries to her. Noor Mohammad @ Khuka the informant's cousin, while preventing the condemned-prisoner from committing assault on PW 7 Laily Begum received a ramdao blow on his shoulder from condemned-prisoner No. 1 Ismail. Noor Mohammad prevented that blow with his left hand which caused the cutting of the half of his left wrist. Acquitted accused Nayan came running and hit Noor Mohammad @ Khuka on his chest with a dagger in his hand. Convicted accused Mokarram @ Mokka felled Noor Mohammad Khuka on the ground by inflicting a blow on him with a bamboo bung in his hand. Convicted accused Habib dealt a lathi blow to PW 2 Md. Anwar Hossain, cousin of the informant. PW 2 Anwar Hossain ran towards his homestead but condemned-prisoner No. 1 Ismail caught him up at the verandah of PW 2 and inflicted severe bleeding injuries to him by striking him with ramdao blows on his neck and shoulder. Another cousin of the informant PW 3 Abdul Quader was trying to rescue the injured persons when convicted accused Habib, Billal and Tuta felled him to the ground with lathi blows. PW 9 Md. Ibrahim Kari younger brother of the informant, came forward to save the injured persons, but acquitted accused Abdur Razzak dealt a dagger blow on his stomach causing serious bleeding injury. Hearing the hue and cry of the informant PW 4 Sekander Ali, Faizur Rahman. PW 5 Abdul Khaleque, PW 13 Mokbul Hossain, Samiruddin and others came to the place of occurrence and saw the occurrence. Upon the arrival of these witnesses convicted accused Mokkaram Hossain injured PW 4 Sekander Ali on his left hand with a bung. Witness Faizur Rahman was beaten and injured by acquitted accused Shahin and one Fazlur Rahman. Convicted accused Mokkaram struck PW 5 Abdul Khaleque with a bung and broke his shoulder. The other accused-persons also had beaten the injured persons indiscriminately with lathis. With the further arrival of other people the accused persons ran away from the place of occurrence. Abdur Razzak and Noor Mohammad @ Khuka died on the spot. Mokhlesur Rahman @ Tara Mia died on his way to Muktagachha Hospital. The other injured persons were taken to Muktagachha Hospital. Some of them were admitted therein and some of them were sent to Mymensingh Medical College for treatment. The accused persons left a dagger and a knife while leaving the place of occurrence.
